en.name: Cowboy
en.ability: On the 1st night, a Minion learns that the Cowboy is in play. Each time they nominate, you are woken that night. Whichever of you is first nominated by the other is executed immediately.

revisions.v1: On the 1st night, a Minion learns that the Cowboy is in play. Each time they nominate, you are woken that night. Whichever of you is first nominated by the other is executed immediately.

en.firstNightReminder: Wake a Minion & tell them the Cowboy is in play.
en.otherNightReminder: If the Minion who learned the Cowboy is in play nominated today, wake the Cowboy.

zh.name: 牛仔
zh.ability: 在首个夜晚，一名爪牙会得知牛仔在场。每当他发起提名，你会在当晚被唤醒。你们中首次被对方提名的玩家立即被处决。

revisions.v1: 在首个夜晚，一名爪牙会得知牛仔在场。每当他发起提名，你会在当晚被唤醒。你们中首次被对方提名的玩家立即被处决。

zh.firstNightReminder: 唤醒一名爪牙，告知他牛仔在场。
zh.otherNightReminder: 如果得知牛仔在场的爪牙发起了提名，唤醒牛仔。
